Do NOT cross-post to the CRE Punch, Lisbon Coast Market or Institute of Applied AI integrations also present on this Postiz instance: those are other projects and orgs.

twitter.note: Nick's own X/Twitter profile (@thenmajor). Postiz's identifier for this provider is 'x', not 'twitter'; the channel key stays 'twitter' because that is what the post frontmatter says. Threads: a post whose body is split into 1/ 2/ 3/ numbered parts is sent as a real thread (one value entry per tweet), so each part must stay under 280 characters. Postiz requires who_can_reply_post on every X post; it is set in defaultSettings.

instagram.note: Nick's own Instagram (realnmajor). Instagram REQUIRES media on every post: the scheduler skips any instagram post with no `media:` frontmatter rather than sending one that would be rejected. Carousels are declared as a directory of slides. Postiz requires post_type (post|story) on every Instagram post; it is set in defaultSettings.
